The app bundle as cached 2026-10-16T10:28Z (436 KB). The whole list is written into it as object literals {id,title,venue,date,time,price,about,image,ticketLink,region,recurring*}; the hash changes with every deploy (three bundles in the cache this week) and the scraper finds it from the shell each run. Region codes and their labels in the same bundle: PT = Provincetown Bear Week, FIBW = Fire Island Bear Weekend, DA = Dore Alley, FL = Folsom Street Fair, SB = Spooky Bear; SB (Spooky Bear) is new since the September recon. Dates print without a year; 241 rows after one object with two clocks splits.

recon.notes: Recheck 2026-10-17 from the cached shell and bundle. 240 objects: 9 live repeats (one entry per clock), 40 upcoming singles, 192 past singles (the summer bear weeks, Dore Alley, Folsom, Fire Island). The venue slot carries three shapes — a name, a street line, or "<Name> <street>" / "<street> (<Name>)" — and the reader split of the mixed shapes is part of this recheck; the row's region CODE must never reach the address (it did, as "PT", on 83 rows of run 20261017-054812).

coverage.basis: Feed door: every object literal in the bundle. Repeats are ONE entry per clock with their nights in the window; dated objects on or after 2026-10-17 are singles; 192 earlier ones are counted as past listings. City is stated only by the row's group (PT/SB → Provincetown, FIBW → Fire Island, DA/FL → San Francisco); ungrouped rows belong to the NYC menu entry.

events.title: Bearded Drag Brunch
events.description:
Pull yourself out of bed (or somebody else's), throw on something fabulous, and float over to The Blue Whale for the BEARDED DRAG BRUNCH — the campiest, hairiest, most deliciously unhinged brunch on the island. Think bottomless mimosas, beards in full beat, and queens who will read you between bites of eggs benedict.

They'll bring the show. You bring the beards. And honey — anything else you want to throw on to get into the spirit— feather boas, last season's caftan, your best Maybelline or that wig you swore you'd never wear in public. The more, the merrier. The messier, the better.

Drag is strongly encouraged. Glamour is non-negotiable. Talent? Optional. It's drag. It's brunch. It's beards. It's everything. Come hungry. Leave glittered.

*$65; $30 with your VIP ACCESS PASS payable to The Blue Whale
